descriptor.name: France IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI)
descriptor.scope: Candidate for bounded Grenoble commune 38185 review, using the national IGN assembly of DGFiP PCI cadastral parcel polygons; no citywide completeness claim.
descriptor.attribution: IGN/DGFiP, Parcellaire Express (PCI), catalogue and updates linked; accessed October 2, 2026. Licence Ouverte 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

evidence: IGN first-party catalogue describes Parcellaire Express (PCI) as cadastral parcel information assembled from DGFiP PCI Vecteur across cadastral France: https://www.data.gouv.fr/datasets/parcellaire-express-pci . Frozen packet and service review identify IGN and Grenoble commune 38185; official WFS exact lookup returned idu 38185000DN0001 with code_insee 38185.

Ville de Grenoble first-party dataset describes Grenoble land-parcel boundaries derived from DGFiP PCI: https://www.data.gouv.fr/datasets/parcelles-grenoble . That separate, publisher-simplified municipal dataset is corroborating scope evidence, not the geometry used for this candidate.
